newsitem.title: CHINA: Xuzhou Machinery to offer 100 mln B shares.
newsitem.headline: Xuzhou Machinery to offer 100 mln B shares.

text.p: Xuzhou Engineering Machinery Co ltd expects to offer 100 million foreign currency B shares in June to raise $30 million to upgrade technology and purchase other plants, a company official said on Wednesday.
The firm, based in Xuzhou in eastern Jiangsu province, is among the 33 domestic enterprises approved recently to list B shares by the Securities Commission of the State Council.
The Southern Securities Co has been named as the main underwriter for the domestic offer but an international coordinator had yet to be found, he said. The pricing of the offer had yet to be fixed.
The B shares would be listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, he said.
The company issued and listed 30 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in August, 1996. Its outstanding shares stood at 120 million.
Xuzhou Machinery's sales reached 800 million yuan ($96.38 million) in 1995, it produced 3,300 engineering machines, including fork-lift trucks and road rollers, he said.
Sales are expected to reach 890 million yuan in 1996, he said. Its net profit per share was expected to reach 0.32 yuan in 1996, he said, but gave no further details.
The overall slowdown in China's engineering machinery building industry had limited the company's growth of sales and profits in recent years, he said.
